
### Install

| Your system | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Linux Mint 22, 22.1, 22.2 or 22.3 (Cinnamon edition), Ubuntu 24.04 with Cinnamon | `cinnarchy-linux-mint-22.deb` |
| LMDE 7, Debian 13 with Cinnamon | `cinnarchy-lmde-7-debian-13.deb` |

Download the file for your system from **Assets** below, double-click it in
your Downloads folder, click **Install Package** and enter your password. Then
start **Omarchy Theme Picker** from the menu. The
[README](https://github.com/CyberJody/cinnarchy#install) has direct download
links for the newest version.

The packages are built from this tag's source by the repository's CI;
`SHA256SUMS` lists their checksums.
